summary: A diagnostic Hair Lab panel composed from existing headings, toggles, value controls and in-place progress.
binding: The explicitly selected hair-lab session and its independent groom document.
x-controls: Preview toggle, a single combined progress/description line, Show (Hair cards, Clumps, Paths, Scalp), Compare with (Game hair, Game cap), and Length/Waves/Volume. Global Undo/History owns hair edit navigation. Hair physics and export remain unavailable for generated hair.
x-refusal: Generation failure restores normal hair and offers a content-width standalone Try again button through the existing request; no path prompts or technical error labels.
